info.title: Smart Waste Management API
info.description: Backend for the Smart Waste Management System. Authenticate with `POST /auth/login`, then send the token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (mobile) or rely on the httpOnly session cookie (web).

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Current user profile and user management (admin)

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Waste reports: own reports (/users/@me/reports) and management (admin)

get.description: Base endpoint to verify that the API is running.

post.description: Register a regular user account and start a session.
Log in with email and password. Returns the session token and also sets it as an httpOnly cookie.

get.description: Get the logged-in user's profile and permissions.

patch.description: Update own name and/or password (password change requires currentPassword).

get.description: List users with search, role and active filters (admin).

post.description: Create a user or admin account (admin).

patch.description: Update a user's name, email, password, role or active status (admin). Deactivating or resetting the password logs the user out.

delete.description: Deactivate a user (admin). Users are never hard-deleted so their reports keep an owner.

get.description: List own reports, newest first, with status/category/date filters.

post.description: Create a report (multipart/form-data) with a photo, GPS location and description. The photo is classified on the server; `category` defaults to the model's result when omitted. Starts as pending.

get.description: Number of own reports per status (user dashboard).
Get an own report with its status history.

patch.description: Edit description, address or category of an own report while it is still pending.

delete.description: Delete an own report while it is still pending.

get.description: List all reports with search (description, address, reporter name) and status/category/user/date filters (admin).
Get a report with its status history (admin).

patch.description: Edit description, address or correct the category of any report (admin).

delete.description: Delete a report and its photo (admin).

patch.description: Change a report's status (pending, in_progress, completed, rejected) and log it. A note is required when rejecting (admin).

post.description: Classify a waste photo (glass, metal, organic, paper, plastic, textile). The photo is center-cropped to a square and resized to 224Ã—224. Results below the confidence threshold come back with recognized=false and category=null. Nothing is stored; use this for an instant preview before creating a report.

get.description: Admin dashboard: totals, reports per status and category, daily trend for the last `days` days, and model agreement. `status` narrows only the daily trend to reports currently in that status.
